subject: SEO Update — ARLO — 2026-09-17
html:
Weekly pulse folded in: rankings still flat (0/22 tracked keywords, avg position 100), backlinks unchanged (3 backlinks / 2 refdomains), CI green (37/37 all-time), all 8 gated connectors in catalog.ts still coming_soon and overdue.

The MCP-integration FOCUS cluster came up empty again (6th straight session), so instead of guessing a destinations-page candidate, pulled fresh keyword data across the 11 still-un-augmented /destinations/[slug] pages. Found a real one: "google sheets alternative" jumped from ~10/mo to a sustained 590/mo (KD 11) five months ago and has held steady since — an order of magnitude bigger and lower-difficulty than every other candidate checked.

/destinations/google_sheetsAdded an "alternative to Google Sheets" comparison section (intro, 6-row feature table, when-to-choose lists) — same proven pattern as the Looker Studio/Power BI/BigQuery/Tableau pages, reusing existing rendering code.google sheets alternative (590/mo, KD 11)askarlo.app/destinations/google_sheets

Next: re-pull FOCUS + destinations-page candidates again next session; watch for any catalog.ts connector flipping to live (would unlock the first new connector-matrix page in months), and re-check "excel alternative" (540/mo, KD 26) as the next-closest destinations candidate if it's still there.
